meta.name: story
meta.description: 网络小说工具箱主入口。根据用户需求自动路由到对应 skill，并可管理作者习惯、启动本地 Dashboard。触发方式：/story、$story、/story dashboard、/网文、「我想写小说」「记住我的写作习惯」「打开工作台」「检查更新」。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 进入网文写作工作台，自动匹配你的创作需求
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你是网络小说作者，想一个入口直达写作工具与习惯。
copy.tagline_en: Step into a web-novel workspace that routes your ideas to the right tools.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're a web novelist looking for a single entry to writing tools and habits.

howto.what: Claude 会先判断你要写什么,再把请求交给对应的写作小工具(写长篇/短篇、拆文、扫榜、审稿等);同时能记录写作习惯、打开本地工作台页面、切换书目并检查版本更新。
howto.when: 当你说出“/story”“/网文”这类命令,或“我想写小说”“打开工作台”等自然语句时触发;没说明篇幅长短就先问你。

say.text: 我想写一部长篇网文,帮我开书、写大纲。
say.note: 会转到对应的长篇写作小工具。

say.text: 记住我的写作习惯:每章结尾留一个悬念。
say.note: 按你的原话存进作者记忆。
启动本地 Dashboard,返回访问网址。

howto.what_en: Claude routes your request to the right web-novel subskill (long/short writing, story analysis, trending scan, review...). It can also save writing habits, open a local dashboard page, switch active books, and check version updates.
howto.when_en: Triggered by “/story” or “/网文”, or natural phrases like “I want to write a novel” or “open the dashboard”. It asks long vs short form if not specified.

say_en.text: I want to write a long web novel. Help me open the book and outline it.
say_en.note: Routes to the long-form writing subskill.

say_en.text: Remember my writing habit: each chapter ends on a cliffhanger.
say_en.note: Saves it into author memory under your exact wording.
Starts the local Dashboard and returns its URL.
